summary: 2026 Desmosedici livery and team wear of BK8 Gresini Racing MotoGP. BK8 NEWS is the title sponsor (front; naming rights and visibility on the bike and racing suits per the team's title-sponsor announcement, confirmed at the 2026 Kuala Lumpur launch). Every other sponsor on the team's official partner page for the MotoGP team - Main, Official and Technical sponsors, logos updated for 2026 - is listed as partner. The page's 'Service and Product Providers' and 'Hospitality Suppliers' sections are suppliers, not sponsors, and are not listed here.
